sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯 DealBook 报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约

sentences.en: Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: What you're seeing right now is the very first COVID-19 vaccine pulling out from the Kalamazoo Pfizer plant.
sentences.zh: 你现在看到的是第一批新冠疫苗从卡拉马祖的辉瑞工厂运出。

sentences.en: Here goes the UPS truck.
sentences.zh: UPS 卡车来了。

sentences.en: An unmarked police car is leading the way.
sentences.zh: 一辆没有标志的警车在前面开道。

sentences.en: People are clapping and cheering.
sentences.zh: 人们在鼓掌欢呼。

sentences.en: There goes the very first shipment.
sentences.zh: 第一批货物运走了。

sentences.en: The FedEx driver is waving to the crowd.
sentences.zh: 联邦快递的司机在向人群挥手。

sentences.en: There it goes.
sentences.zh: 它走了。

sentences.en: Shipments of the newly approved COVID-19 vaccine are on the way right now to hotspots nationwide.
sentences.zh: 新获批的新冠疫苗正运往全国各地的疫情热点地区。

sentences.en: 920,000 doses are now being spread throughout the United States.
sentences.zh: 92万剂疫苗目前正分发到美国各地。

sentences.en: We're getting the first doses here into LA with that FedEx plane arriving.
sentences.zh: 随着那架联邦快递飞机的抵达，我们在这里收到了第一批运抵洛杉矶的疫苗。

sentences.en: You see this truck here making a very important delivery.
sentences.zh: 你看这辆卡车正在进行一次非常重要的运送。

sentences.en: This is in Phoenix.
sentences.zh: 这是在菲尼克斯。

sentences.en: The first shipments arrived in Minnesota here within the last 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 第一批货物在过去15分钟内抵达了明尼苏达州。

sentences.en: Vaccine is now in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 疫苗现在到了俄亥俄州。

sentences.en: The COVID-19 vaccine is in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 新冠疫苗已抵达艾奥瓦州。

sentences.en: So we are about to welcome the vaccines.
sentences.zh: 所以我们即将迎来疫苗。

sentences.en: The very first vaccines here in Colorado.
sentences.zh: 这是科罗拉多州的第一批疫苗。

sentences.en: Any minute now we're going to hear a doorbell and then we're going to of course let the vaccine in.
sentences.zh: 随时都可能听到门铃响，然后我们当然会把疫苗接进来。

sentences.en: Oh, there we go.
sentences.zh: 哦，来了。

sentences.en: Do we have to sign for it?
sentences.zh: 我们需要签收吗？

sentences.en: I'll sign for it.
sentences.zh: 我来签收。

sentences.en: This really is the day we've been waiting for.
sentences.zh: 这确实是我们一直在等待的日子。

sentences.en: It starts the process of the end.
sentences.zh: 它开启了终结的进程。

sentences.en: We know the end is a long way off, but the end now is in sight.
sentences.zh: 我们知道离终点还很远，但终点现在已在望。

sentences.en: With this shipment, we start to see victory.
sentences.zh: 有了这批货物，我们开始看到胜利。

sentences.en: We start to see our ability to preserve life and protect our people.
sentences.zh: 我们开始看到我们有能力挽救生命并保护我们的人民。

sentences.en: We are going to defeat
sentences.zh: 我们将战胜

sentences.en: COVID.
sentences.zh: 新冠病毒。

sentences.en: It starts right there.
sentences.zh: 就从这里开始。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, as the death toll surpasses 300,000, the first doses of a vaccine are administered in the
sentences.zh: 今天，随着死亡人数超过30万，第一批疫苗在美国

sentences.en: United States.
sentences.zh: 开始接种。

sentences.en: What it was like from North Dakota to New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 从北达科他州到新奥尔良，情况是怎样的。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, December 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月15日，星期二。

sentences.en: Did you know which box it was right away?
sentences.zh: 你一眼就认出是哪个箱子了吗？

sentences.en: It came singly.
sentences.zh: 它是单独运来的。

sentences.en: So was it easy to spot on the truck or did you know right away?
sentences.zh: 所以是在卡车上很容易辨认，还是你一眼就知道了？

sentences.en: Well, the truck driver, the actual FedEx driver that brought it just brought this in.
sentences.zh: 嗯，卡车司机，就是那个送货的联邦快递司机，刚刚把它送进来了。

sentences.en: Oh, just brought the watch?
sentences.zh: 哦，刚把那个箱子送来？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm Jack Healy and I'm in Fargo, North Dakota, one of the states that has been most devastated by the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 我是杰克·希利，我现在在北达科他州的法戈，这是受新冠疫情影响最严重的州之一。

sentences.en: And I'm here chasing a box of coronavirus vaccine that arrived early Monday morning at the Sanford Medical Center.
sentences.zh: 我在这里追踪一箱周一清晨抵达桑福德医疗中心的新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: All I know is, uh, I don't know if I'm the first guy in North Dakota to receive it.
sentences.zh: 我只知道，呃，我不知道我是不是北达科他州第一个收到它的人。

sentences.en: We not actually receive it, but receive it.
sentences.zh: 不是真的收到它，而是接收它。

sentences.en: Receive it, yeah.
sentences.zh: 接收它，是的。

sentences.en: I started the day at about seven o'clock when I got a text message from the local hospital here in
sentences.zh: 我从早上七点左右开始这一天，当时我收到了当地医院发来的一条短信，

sentences.en: Fargo saying that the shipment they had been waiting for all weekend had finally arrived.
sentences.zh: 说他们整个周末都在等待的货物终于到了。

sentences.en: They had been expecting it at about 10.30 or 11.30 or so on Monday, but it showed up at the hospital at precisely 7.02 a.m.
sentences.zh: 他们原本预计周一上午10点半或11点半左右到达，但它在早上7点02分准时出现在医院。

sentences.en: And it was met there by a guy by the name of Tim
sentences.zh: 在那里迎接它的是一个叫蒂姆·

sentences.en: Ostgarten.
sentences.zh: 奥斯特加滕的人。

sentences.en: The biggest shipment you ever received in your career.
sentences.zh: 这是你职业生涯中收到的最大一批货物吧。

sentences.en: Well, history is what it is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，历史就是这样。

sentences.en: It was a big white box containing three trays, each with 975 doses of coronavirus vaccine.
sentences.zh: 那是一个巨大的白色箱子，里面装着三个托盘，每个托盘有975剂新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: The box had come off of the line of a Pfizer manufacturing facility in Kalamazoo, Michigan,
sentences.zh: 这个箱子来自密歇根州卡拉马祖的辉瑞制造工厂的生产线，

sentences.en: and it had traveled from Michigan onto a plane to Memphis where it had sat overnight before being flown into Fargo.
sentences.zh: 它从密歇根州运到孟菲斯，在飞机上过了一夜，然后被空运到法戈。

sentences.en: A Pfizer official told the hospital in Fargo that the supply of vaccine was one of the first across the country to arrive, and it was arriving in a place that needs it desperately.
sentences.zh: 辉瑞的一位官员告诉法戈的医院，这批疫苗是全国首批抵达的疫苗之一，而且它抵达了一个急需它的地方。

sentences.en: What did you think when you realized, you know, what was in the package?
sentences.zh: 当你意识到包裹里装的是什么时，你有什么想法？

sentences.en: Just, I was kind of wondering when, if and when, if I get the shot, who knows?
sentences.zh: 只是，我有点好奇，如果我能接种疫苗，什么时候接种，谁知道呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: North Dakota has had one of the highest case rates in the entire country.
sentences.zh: 北达科他州的病例率在全国名列前茅。

sentences.en: It's a place where a lot of smaller rural towns have overloaded hospitals.
sentences.zh: 这里有很多小型农村城镇的医院已经不堪重负。

sentences.en: It's a place where people were slow to embrace masking and social distancing and any sorts of restrictions on business.
sentences.zh: 这里的人们对佩戴口罩、保持社交距离以及任何形式的商业限制反应迟缓。

sentences.en: And as a result of that and some other issues, hospitals have been really overwhelmed and filling up faSt.
sentences.zh: 结果就是这样，加上其他一些问题，医院真的已经人满为患，而且填满的速度很快。

sentences.en: So after the box arrived, it was wheeled down the halls into a pharmacy storage room where the hospital staff had been preparing for it.
sentences.zh: 所以箱子到达后，它被推过走廊，送进了一个药房储藏室，医院工作人员一直在那里为它做准备。

sentences.en: Yeah, so we're waiting for a final number for how many we're going to get at the West Campus.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们正在等待西校区最终能收到多少剂量的确切数字。

sentences.en: But we can go do that part now.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在可以去做那部分工作了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Oh yeah, could I at least get my set up?
sentences.zh: 哦对了，我至少能把我的设备准备好吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, let's go get that up.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们去准备吧。

sentences.en: There was a new deep freezer to keep the vaccine stored at these ultra-cold temperatures that are necessary to keep its effectiveness.
sentences.zh: 那里有一个新的深冷冰柜，用于将疫苗储存在保持其有效性所必需的超低温环境下。

sentences.en: And once it arrived, people just kind of stared at it.
sentences.zh: 一旦它到了，人们就只是盯着它看。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: I feel like we need the trumpets.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们需要号角声。

sentences.en: We need the trumpets to sound.
sentences.zh: 我们需要吹响号角。

sentences.en: They were inspecting the shipping labels on the box.
sentences.zh: 他们正在检查箱子上的运输标签。

sentences.en: They were taking pictures of it.
sentences.zh: 他们在给它拍照。

sentences.en: A couple of them were taking pictures with it.
sentences.zh: 其中几个人在和它合影。

sentences.en: We were taking pictures of it.
sentences.zh: 我们在给它拍照。

sentences.en: It was this kind of object of fascination.
sentences.zh: 它成了某种令人着迷的对象。

sentences.en: It was almost like this sort of miraculous thing had landed there that so many people have staked their hopes on.
sentences.zh: 就像某种奇迹般的东西降临在那里，许多人都把希望寄托在它身上。

sentences.en: But really, it was time to get to work.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，是时候开始工作了。

sentences.en: And so the hospital's pharmacy staff started to take the vaccine out.
sentences.zh: 于是医院的药房工作人员开始把疫苗取出来。

sentences.en: So what are you guys seeing right now from the probe readings?
sentences.zh: 那么你们现在从探头读数中看到了什么？

sentences.en: And that's a pretty complicated process.
sentences.zh: 那是一个相当复杂的过程。

sentences.en: It's not just like opening a regular box.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是打开一个普通的盒子。

sentences.en: It's just pretty much once you hold it for three seconds, then the lights will tell you it's a fail or not a fail.
sentences.zh: 基本上，一旦你按住它三秒钟，指示灯就会告诉你它是成功还是失败。

sentences.en: And technically, it just tells you if it's been within range during the shipment.
sentences.zh: 从技术上讲，它只是告诉你运输过程中温度是否在范围内。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So it flashed green.
sentences.zh: 它闪烁了绿灯。

sentences.en: So we know the green means okay.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道绿色意味着正常。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So there was a little digital sensor there that had flashing green and red lights.
sentences.zh: 那里有一个小的数字传感器，有闪烁的绿灯和红灯。

sentences.en: And a red light was bad.
sentences.zh: 红灯表示不好。

sentences.en: That meant that there was a problem with the temperature.
sentences.zh: 那意味着温度有问题。

sentences.en: And a green light was good.
sentences.zh: 绿灯表示好。

sentences.en: And the lights were green.
sentences.zh: 灯是绿色的。

sentences.en: And so that was great.
sentences.zh: 所以那太棒了。

sentences.en: And so they could move on to the next step.
sentences.zh: 于是他们可以进行下一步了。

sentences.en: And the next step was removing this big bag of dry ice from the box that was covering up the vaccine itself.
sentences.zh: 下一步是从箱子里取出覆盖在疫苗上的那一大袋干冰。

sentences.en: And it was just like a scene in the movies with, you know, clouds of dry ice drifting all over the room.
sentences.zh: 这就像电影里的场景，你知道，干冰产生的云雾在房间里四处飘散。

sentences.en: Once that was disposed of and out of the way, the pharmacy manager lifted the three trays of the vaccine out of the box and quickly slid them into the deep freezer.
sentences.zh: 处理掉这些干冰后，药房经理从箱子里取出了三个疫苗托盘，并迅速将它们滑入深冷冰柜。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太神奇了。

sentences.en: This whole process had to occur in five minutes or less because of the rules about how cold you have to keep this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 整个过程必须在五分钟或更短时间内完成，因为有关于疫苗必须保持多低温的规定。

sentences.en: And so it was a performance that was really timed to a tee.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一场时间掐得非常准的表演。

sentences.en: Now that the vaccine was there, it was time to start giving it out to employees.
sentences.zh: 既然疫苗到了，是时候开始给员工接种了。

sentences.en: And I went over to the location that
sentences.zh: 我去了桑福德医院指定为首批疫苗接种中心之一的地点。

sentences.en: Sanford has designated as one of its first vaccine centers.
sentences.zh: 我站在医院地下室一个没有窗户的房间里，这里通常用作退伍军人的休息室。

sentences.en: So I'm standing in a windowless room in the basement of the hospital that's usually used as a lounge for for veterans.
sentences.zh: 今天它被改造成了一个临时疫苗接种站。

sentences.en: And today it has been repurposed into a makeshift vaccination station.
sentences.zh: 门外排着穿着刷手服和西装的医生和护士，他们都戴着口罩，每个人都在等待走到桌前，那里有戴着护目镜的护士

sentences.en: There are docs and nurses and scrubs and suits, all wearing face masks lined up outside the door, each waiting to go up to a table where nurses in goggles
sentences.zh: 准备好注射器和文书工作，开始分发疫苗。

sentences.en: are waiting and ready with, uh, syringes and paperwork to start meeting out this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 我和几位护士、医生以及其他工作人员谈了谈这一天的意义，以及在经历了这么多真正可怕的月份后，这是否可能成为一个转折点。

sentences.en: And I talked with a few nurses and doctors and other staff about what this day meant and whether this might be a turning point after so many truly terrible months.
sentences.zh: 等一下，让我往高处站一点。

sentences.en: One second, let me get a little higher up here.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: Oh, sure.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间陪我们。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for hanging out with us.
sentences.zh: 哦，没关系。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 其中一位是里奇·塞斯医生。

sentences.en: And one of them was Dr. Richie Seth.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你和我聊天。

sentences.en: Thank you for chatting with me.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我们真的很想听听一线医生和护士的观点，

sentences.en: Um, you know, we're, we're just kind of really interested in hearing the perspective of, you know, frontline
sentences.zh: 他们每天都在与新冠患者一起工作，观察并治疗他们，了解这种疫苗的重要性。

sentences.en: docs and nurses, um, you know, who are working with COVID patients every day and seeing them and treating them about the significance of this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对你来说是什么样的？

sentences.en: Um, what have been for you?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你现在的一天是怎么过的？

sentences.en: I mean, like, what's your day like right now?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你在特殊护理病房工作。

sentences.en: Um, you work in the special care unit.
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 今天我在特殊护理病房工作。

sentences.en: Today I worked in the special care unit.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 所以你真正做的是，你首先要做的是看病人。

sentences.en: So really what you're doing is your first thing you're sick is patients.
sentences.zh: 今天我有四位病情非常严重的病人。

sentences.en: So today I have, uh, four very sick patients.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 所以我们立即去看他们，嗯，看看他们的情况如何。

sentences.en: So we go immediately to see them, um, see how they're doing.
sentences.zh: 他们好转了吗？

sentences.en: Are they getting better?
sentences.zh: 他们恶化了吗？

sentences.en: Are they getting worse?
sentences.zh: 我们可以做哪些药物调整？

sentences.en: Any medication adjustments that we can do?
sentences.zh: 嗯，和我们每一位重症患者一样，我们会与每位患者讨论护理目标。

sentences.en: Um, and then as with every one of our sick patients, we have goals of care discussion with every patient.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So we talk about what's our plan, what is our goal and what happens if they get worse?
sentences.zh: 我们谈论过我们的计划是什么，目标是什么，如果他们病情恶化该怎么办？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: What, what are those discussions like when you say what happens if they get worse?
sentences.zh: 当你提到“如果他们病情恶化该怎么办”时，那些讨论通常是什么样的？

sentences.en: I mean, it's going to be a difficult conversation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那将是一场艰难的谈话。

sentences.en: Um, you know, if it was on the first day, you're right.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，如果是在第一天，你是对的。

sentences.en: It's a very difficult discussion as the patients experience a lot of fear.
sentences.zh: 随着患者经历巨大的恐惧，这确实是一个非常艰难的讨论。

sentences.en: They're very nervous.
sentences.zh: 他们非常紧张。

sentences.en: Um, but you'd be surprised after the third, fourth, fifth day, 10th day, and they're not getting better.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但你会惊讶地发现，到了第三、第四、第五天，甚至是第十天，如果他们没有好转。

sentences.en: Sometimes they'll tell us, they'll come to this realization saying, I don't want to be intubated.
sentences.zh: 有时他们会告诉我们，他们会意识到这一点，说：我不想插管。

sentences.en: I don't want to be on a ventilator or they'll say, I think I have a lot of fight in me.
sentences.zh: 我不想用呼吸机，或者他们会说，我觉得我还有很强的求生欲。

sentences.en: I really need to, to keep going.
sentences.zh: 我真的需要，需要坚持下去。

sentences.en: I have an example.
sentences.zh: 我有一个例子。

sentences.en: It's a really interesting case where I had
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的案例，我曾遇到过

sentences.en: most of our patients are in private rooms, individual rooms, but when in the beginning
sentences.zh: 我们的大多数病人都在私人病房，单人病房，但在我们搜索的初期

sentences.en: of our search, we had a situation where one of our critical care patients rooms, they had two people in there.
sentences.zh: 我们曾遇到过一种情况，我们的一间重症监护病房里住了两个人。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So one of my patients was, you know, he was in a rough shape, but he, but he was still maintaining his oxygen and we were trying to avoid intubation.
sentences.zh: 所以我的一个病人，你知道，他的情况很糟糕，但他，但他还在维持血氧，我们当时正试图避免插管。

sentences.en: So he was sitting on one room side of the room and I crossed the side.
sentences.zh: 他坐在房间的一侧，我走到了那边。

sentences.en: He had seen three patients who had come in, intubated and deteriorated and died in that room.
sentences.zh: 他目睹了三个住进那个房间的病人，他们插了管，病情恶化，然后去世了。

sentences.en: And, and two of them had coded.
sentences.zh: 而且，其中两个人还经历了抢救。

sentences.en: So what a code means is that they needed CPR and they needed, uh, lots of medications to prop them up.
sentences.zh: 抢救的意思是他们需要心肺复苏，需要大量的药物来维持生命。

sentences.en: So he had seen how, uh, how bad it can be if they don't get better.
sentences.zh: 所以他看到了，如果病情没有好转，情况会有多糟糕。

sentences.en: So he came to me and said, I don't want that.
sentences.zh: 于是他来找我说，我不想要那样。

sentences.en: I know what I want and I don't want to be intubated.
sentences.zh: 我知道我想要什么，我不希望被插管。

sentences.en: I don't want the CPR.
sentences.zh: 我不需要心肺复苏。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's a, it was a really, he was, it was a, this is a really tough case.
sentences.zh: 那是一个，这确实是一个非常艰难的案例。

sentences.en: Did he get better or?
sentences.zh: 他好转了吗？还是？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Um, he, uh, his case was one that gets pretty emotional because he, he was like a friend.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他，他的案例让人非常感伤，因为他，他就像个朋友一样。

sentences.en: He became a friend, you know, when you take care of these patients for 10 days, um, you, you, you develop a really special bond.
sentences.zh: 他成了朋友，你知道，当你照顾这些病人长达10天时，你会建立起一种非常特殊的纽带。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: For 10 days, you're talking about oxygen.
sentences.zh: 这10天里，你谈论的是氧气。

sentences.en: But then you start talking about like, you know, where are they from their family?
sentences.zh: 但随后你开始谈论，你知道，他们离家人有多远？

sentences.en: So I got to, I got to know and talk to his daughters and, and he told me about his work and his life and where he was born.
sentences.zh: 所以我得以了解并与他的女儿们交谈，他告诉了我他的工作、他的生活以及他出生的地方。

sentences.en: And so you get to really know these people.
sentences.zh: 所以你真的会深入了解这些人。

sentences.en: And on the two days before he passed away, we were FaceTiming with his daughter and he was clinically not improving.
sentences.zh: 在他去世前两天，我们和他的女儿进行了FaceTime通话，他的临床状况并没有好转。

sentences.en: He could tell that he was tiring out.
sentences.zh: 他能感觉到自己正在耗尽精力。

sentences.en: So as we were talking to his daughter, you know, he said, um, I think my time is up.
sentences.zh: 所以当我们和他的女儿交谈时，他说，嗯，我想我的时间到了。

sentences.en: Um, I don't think I can fight anymore.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想我再也无法坚持战斗了。

sentences.en: And then he had told her where he wanted his ashes to be spread.
sentences.zh: 然后他告诉她他希望将骨灰撒在哪里。

sentences.en: And then he told both his daughters how much, how proud he was of them.
sentences.zh: 接着他告诉两个女儿他有多为她们感到骄傲。

sentences.en: They were both in college.
sentences.zh: 她们当时都在上大学。

sentences.en: And so we were FaceTiming.
sentences.zh: 所以我们当时正在进行FaceTime通话。

sentences.en: And when did this happen?
sentences.zh: 这事发生在什么时候？

sentences.en: I think it was a month and a half ago.
sentences.zh: 我想是一个半月前。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I mean, to, to experience that, I mean, and you, you were working in the unit this morning, it sounds like, right.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，去经历这些，而且你今天早上还在病房工作，听起来是这样，对吧。

sentences.en: And then to come to get this vaccine, I mean, it's just got to be a pretty, it's a dichotomy, right?
sentences.zh: 然后又来接种疫苗，这真是一种，这是一种二分法，对吧？

sentences.en: It's like, it's two ends of the spectrum.
sentences.zh: 就像是，光谱的两端。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's, it's, you're still fighting a battle and that you're starting to see the horizon.
sentences.zh: 这，这，你仍然在进行一场战斗，但你开始看到地平线了。

sentences.en: That's why it's so emotional because like in March, you remember in March when there was like, when there was a sense of dread, you know, there was, there was fear.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么它如此感人，因为就像在三月，你还记得三月那种恐惧感吗，你知道，那种恐惧。

sentences.en: There was little hope out there, but now there's, there's a, there's a sunrise.
sentences.zh: 那时几乎没有希望，但现在，有，有，有曙光了。

sentences.en: Um, in North Dakota, you'll see the greatest sunrises.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在北达科他州，你会看到最壮丽的日出。

sentences.en: And today is the most beautiful sunrise.
sentences.zh: 而今天就是最美丽的日出。

sentences.en: Um, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: And you're going to go get the shot now.
sentences.zh: 你现在要去打疫苗了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess so.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是吧。

sentences.en: Okay, cool.
sentences.zh: 好的，太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I hope you enjoy Fargo.
sentences.zh: 希望你在法戈过得愉快。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: What are you leaving?
sentences.zh: 你要离开了吗？

sentences.en: Um, the New York Times app
sentences.zh: 嗯，纽约时报的应用程序

sentences.en: unlocked.
sentences.zh: 已解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Hi, is this, is this Mona?
sentences.zh: 嗨，请问是，是莫娜吗？

sentences.en: Is this Mona?
sentences.zh: 是莫娜吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: On Monday afternoon, I spoke with Mona Magura, an inpatient pharmacist in New Orleans.
sentences.zh: 周一下午，我与新奥尔良的一位住院药剂师莫娜·马古拉进行了交谈。

sentences.en: I know this is a really busy day in your hospital.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们医院今天非常忙。

sentences.en: And I believe that you have just ended a very long shift in your hospital.
sentences.zh: 而且我相信你刚刚结束了医院里非常漫长的一班岗。

sentences.en: I wish.
sentences.zh: 我倒希望是这样。

sentences.en: It ends at eight.
sentences.zh: 八点才结束。

sentences.en: But no worries at all.
sentences.zh: 不过没关系。

sentences.en: I will take any break.
sentences.zh: 我会利用任何休息时间。

sentences.en: Well, thank you for spending your break with us.
sentences.zh: 好吧，谢谢你把休息时间留给我们。

sentences.en: Just so people understand how you fit into this historic day.
sentences.zh: 为了让大家了解你是如何参与这个历史性的一天的。

sentences.en: Tell me about the hospital where you work.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你工作的医院吧。

sentences.en: And tell us what you do there.
sentences.zh: 并告诉我们你在那里做什么。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So I'm an inpatient pharmacist here at Oshner Main Campus.
sentences.zh: 我是奥什纳主校区的住院药剂师。

sentences.en: Oshner Main Campus is in
sentences.zh: 奥什纳主校区位于

sentences.en: New Orleans with St. Jefferson Parish.
sentences.zh: 新奥尔良的杰斐逊教区。

sentences.en: Oshner is very big in the city, but Main Campus is definitely the hub of it all.
sentences.zh: 奥什纳在城里规模很大，但主校区绝对是这一切的中心。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So you're a vital part of the New Orleans medical system, this hospital.
sentences.zh: 所以你是新奥尔良医疗系统，也就是这家医院的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're huge.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们规模很大。

sentences.en: We're one of the biggest hospitals in this whole area.
sentences.zh: 我们是整个地区最大的医院之一。

sentences.en: I'm pretty sure we gave the first vaccine in the state today.
sentences.zh: 我很确定我们今天在州内完成了首例疫苗接种。

sentences.en: Well, that's why we wanted to talk to you, because you are actually involved in administering the vaccine on this first day.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是我们想和你交谈的原因，因为你实际上参与了第一天的疫苗接种工作。

sentences.en: I mean, and from what I can tell, you're involved in literally injecting the vaccine into the people you work with in the hospital from the pharmacy division of the hospital.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，据我所知，你确实参与了从医院药剂部门为你的同事注射疫苗的工作。

sentences.en: And so you were literally giving people protection from the virus, which is a pretty extraordinary role to play.
sentences.zh: 所以你是在亲手为人们提供病毒防护，这是一个非常了不起的角色。

sentences.en: Yeah, I totally agree.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全同意。

sentences.en: We definitely feel as a whole, this is like the first proactive step towards, you know, just battling this whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我们作为一个整体确实感觉到，这是对抗这一切的第一步主动措施。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you say proactive.
sentences.zh: 你说“主动”。

sentences.en: In other words, everything else you have done has been kind of one step behind the virus, trying to catch up with it and stop it.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，你们之前所做的一切都像是比病毒慢了一步，试图追赶并阻止它。

sentences.en: You're saying this is the first time you can actually do something to get ahead of it.
sentences.zh: 你是说这是你们第一次能够真正采取行动走在它前面。

sentences.en: A hundred percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之百。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of people feel the vaccine's going to cure it all, fix it all.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多人觉得疫苗能治愈一切，解决一切问题。

sentences.en: This is just one step towards the bigger picture.
sentences.zh: 这只是迈向更大目标的一步。

sentences.en: We're definitely still practicing wearing masks, social distancing.
sentences.zh: 我们肯定还在坚持戴口罩、保持社交距离。

sentences.en: It's going to take a while, but I think this is a step in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 这需要一段时间，但我认为这是朝着正确方向迈出的一步。

sentences.en: It's been a long road.
sentences.zh: 这是一条漫长的道路。

sentences.en: It's been long nine months, but yeah, we're so ecstatic.
sentences.zh: 这九个月太漫长了，但是的，我们非常激动。

sentences.en: Well, let me just ask you about that long road for a moment.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我问问你关于那段漫长的道路。

sentences.en: I want to get to what it was like to actually administer this vaccine, but I'm curious what the pandemic has been like for you up to this point.
sentences.zh: 我想了解实际接种疫苗是什么感觉，但我很好奇到目前为止这场大流行对你来说意味着什么。

sentences.en: New Orleans was hit pretty early and it was hit really hard.
sentences.zh: 新奥尔良很早就受到了冲击，而且冲击非常严重。

sentences.en: We've done a couple of episodes about the pandemic in your city.
sentences.zh: 我们制作了几期关于你们城市大流行的节目。

sentences.en: So just give me a sense of what it has been like from your perspective up until now.
sentences.zh: 所以，请从你的角度告诉我到目前为止的情况。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, I mean, New Orleans is a big city.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的意思是，新奥尔良是一个大城市。

sentences.en: I think it was not in our favor, definitely after Mardi Gras was when this kind of heightened and, you know, they've said that that's where a lot of it could have transferred.
sentences.zh: 我认为这并不利于我们，特别是在狂欢节之后，情况加剧了，你知道，他们说很多传播可能就是在那时发生的。

sentences.en: This is a port city, a tourist city.
sentences.zh: 这是一个港口城市，一个旅游城市。

sentences.en: So we've definitely got hit pretty hard.
sentences.zh: 所以我们确实受到了相当严重的打击。

sentences.en: So we have come to work every single day.
sentences.zh: 所以我们每天都来上班。

sentences.en: And especially like, you know, in the beginning, no matter how people feel about it now in the beginning, honestly, I think we were all terrified.
sentences.zh: 尤其是，你知道，在初期，无论人们现在怎么看，老实说，我认为我们当时都吓坏了。

sentences.en: And it was literally like every day I'm going into a hospital full of patients.
sentences.zh: 真的就像每天我都走进一家挤满病人的医院。

sentences.en: And we were literally walking towards the fire every single day, day in and out, especially having two elderly parents.
sentences.zh: 我们每天都在向火场走去，日复一日，尤其是还有两位年迈的父母。

sentences.en: It was a lot to, you know, go home and being terrified of maybe I'm going to bring it home to them.
sentences.zh: 回家时感到非常恐惧，担心我可能会把病毒带给他们，这压力很大。

sentences.en: You know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: So it's been a little exhausting.
sentences.zh: 所以这让人有点精疲力竭。

sentences.en: That's why this is definitely such an amazing day for all of us.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这对我们所有人来说绝对是如此美妙的一天。

sentences.en: We're just so excited to be here to finally have something, you know, substantial that we can offer the community.
sentences.zh: 我们非常高兴能来到这里，终于有了可以提供给社区的实质性东西。

sentences.en: So tell me about this day, Monday, vaccine day, when it all starts to happen.
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我这一天，周一，疫苗接种日，当一切开始发生的时候。

sentences.en: I mean, tell me about when you arrived at the hospital and what the scene was and what you did.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，告诉我你到达医院时的情况，现场是什么样的，你做了什么。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, right when I arrived, it was actually funny.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我刚到的时候，其实挺有趣的。

sentences.en: The vaccine was, you know, they delivered it at the dock and that's when we started.
sentences.zh: 疫苗，你知道，他们把它送到码头，我们就从那时开始了。

sentences.en: It was go time.
sentences.zh: 出发时刻到了。

sentences.en: So we were ready to go, you know, with the syringes and the cleaning utensils, the band-aids, and we headed towards the area that we were administering.
sentences.zh: 所以我们准备好了，带着注射器、清洁用品、创可贴，然后前往我们进行接种的区域。

sentences.en: And it was kind of just another day with a lot of cameras.
sentences.zh: 那就像是又一个有很多摄像头的日子。

sentences.en: Could you tell me about your, your first patient, your first vaccination?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我关于你的，你的第一个病人，你的第一次接种吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: My first vaccination was a female.
sentences.zh: 我的第一次接种对象是一位女性。

sentences.en: She was one of the nurses here at Ochsner.
sentences.zh: 她是奥什纳的一名护士。

sentences.en: And of course, I always ask the patient the first question, which arm would you prefer it in?
sentences.zh: 当然，我总是会问病人第一个问题：你更喜欢打哪只手臂？

sentences.en: So I drew up one dose, you know, of course, clean the area and then just go ahead and stick them.
sentences.zh: 所以我抽取了一剂剂量，你知道，当然，清洁该区域，然后直接给他们注射。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: How many people, Mona, did you, did you vaccinate today?
sentences.zh: 莫娜，你今天一共为多少人接种了疫苗？

sentences.en: I wish I counted.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我数过。

sentences.en: I lost count about, um, I want to say about 20 to 30, but I'm at 60 for now.
sentences.zh: 我数到大概，嗯，我想说是20到30个左右，但我现在已经接种了60个了。

sentences.en: And then after this call, I'm ahead right back there till tonight.
sentences.zh: 在这通电话之后，我得马上回去工作，一直忙到今晚。

sentences.en: Did you get the vaccine today?
sentences.zh: 你今天接种疫苗了吗？

sentences.en: I did not.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: So as a pharmacist, um, I'm not in direct care with COVID positive patients.
sentences.zh: 作为一名药剂师，嗯，我并不直接护理新冠阳性患者。

sentences.en: So I'll be in the second round.
sentences.zh: 所以我会在第二轮接种。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So I am ready and waiting.
sentences.zh: 所以我已经准备好，在等待了。

sentences.en: If I could give it to myself, I would.
sentences.zh: 如果能给自己打，我肯定会打的。

sentences.en: But I will wait till the next phase.
sentences.zh: 但我会等到下一阶段。

sentences.en: I'm curious when the day is over and you do have time to, to pause and really think about what it meant.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，当这一天结束，你有时间停下来，真正思考这一天意味着什么的时候。

sentences.en: What do you think that this day and what you did today will mean to you?
sentences.zh: 你认为今天这一天以及你所做的一切，对你意味着什么？

sentences.en: I mean, just as my career, my pharmacy career, I mean, this is like the top of my life is for me personally, this is an amazing experience.
sentences.zh: 我是说，就我的职业生涯，我的药剂师生涯而言，这对我个人来说是人生巅峰，这是一次了不起的经历。

sentences.en: Um, I never thought I would play this role of vaccinating the first person in the entire state of Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我从没想过我会扮演这个角色，为整个路易斯安那州的第一人接种疫苗。

sentences.en: So it's just mind blowing.
sentences.zh: 所以这简直令人难以置信。

sentences.en: You, you, you, you buried, you buried the lead here.
sentences.zh: 你，你，你，你把重点给漏了。

sentences.en: That's a big thing to have done.
sentences.zh: 这可是件大事。

sentences.en: I, I, I'm really trying, you know, um, you know, it's honestly an honor to be here today to have been a small part of this huge process.
sentences.zh: 我，我，我真的在努力，你知道，嗯，你知道，能参与到这个宏大进程的一小部分，我真的感到非常荣幸。

sentences.en: Is this going to be your, your work and your life for the next foreseeable period of time delivering this vaccine?
sentences.zh: 在可预见的未来，你的工作和生活重心都会是分发这种疫苗吗？

sentences.en: So, I mean, I still have shifts here that I need to work.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在这里还有需要完成的轮班。

sentences.en: So, um, I'm still on the schedule to do my regular, you know, IV shifts.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我的日程表上还有常规的，你知道，静脉注射轮班。

sentences.en: Um, but any minute I can get in the day, any, I'll work doubles until, you know, we can make a dent in this, but yeah, today and tomorrow I will be vaccinating.
sentences.zh: 但是，只要我一天里能挤出时间，任何时间，我都会加倍工作，直到，你知道，我们能在这方面取得进展，但是的，今天和明天我都会负责接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And then, you know, the rest of the week, I'm just going to go back to the pharmacy and do my job.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，这周剩下的时间，我就回药房做我的本职工作。

sentences.en: Like I do every day.
sentences.zh: 就像我每天做的那样。

sentences.en: But I think tonight when I slow down, I will definitely, I texted my husband, what's for dinner?
sentences.zh: 但我认为今晚当我慢下来的时候，我肯定会，我给丈夫发了短信，问晚餐吃什么？

sentences.en: And he's like, what do you mean?
sentences.zh: 他说，你什么意思？

sentences.en: Like, how was your day?
sentences.zh: 就像是，你今天过得怎么样？

sentences.en: And I was like, it's cool.
sentences.zh: 我说，挺酷的。

sentences.en: I'll see you when I get home.
sentences.zh: 我回家再见你。

sentences.en: So yeah, it's, it's weird.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，这，这很奇怪。

sentences.en: I think it's just a second nature.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这只是第二天性。

sentences.en: That's what we do every day.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们每天做的事情。

sentences.en: And we've been waiting for this day for so long that I was like, you can't mess this up.
sentences.zh: 我们为这一天等了太久，所以我当时想，你绝对不能搞砸了。

sentences.en: This is it.
sentences.zh: 就是现在了。

sentences.en: So it was pretty awesome.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很棒。

sentences.en: It's still pretty awesome.
sentences.zh: 现在依然感觉很棒。

sentences.en: It's happening right now.
sentences.zh: 这一切正在发生。

sentences.en: You know, you know, we've all been waiting for this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你知道，我们都在等待这一刻。

sentences.en: So yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以是的。

sentences.en: Well, what is for dinner?
sentences.zh: 那么，晚餐吃什么？

sentences.en: I don't know, but it better be good.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但最好好吃点。

sentences.en: It better be damn good.
sentences.zh: 最好是好吃得不得了。

sentences.en: It better be good.
sentences.zh: 最好好吃点。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You deserve it.
sentences.zh: 你应得的。

sentences.en: You deserve it.
sentences.zh: 你应得的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, we're really thrilled to have met you and, uh,
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们真的很高兴能见到你，而且，呃，

sentences.en: I don't live in new Orleans, but I'm grateful for you.
sentences.zh: 我不住在新奥尔良，但我很感激你。

sentences.en: So thank you.
sentences.zh: 所以谢谢你。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, we want you to come one day.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们希望有一天你能来。

sentences.en: So this is the whole point, you know, we're definitely trying to make it, you know, a bit of normalcy.
sentences.zh: 这就是重点，你知道，我们绝对是在努力让一切，你知道，恢复一点常态。

sentences.en: We want our tourists back.
sentences.zh: 我们希望游客回来。

sentences.en: We want, we want the city back.
sentences.zh: 我们希望，我们希望这座城市回来。

sentences.en: We want everything, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们希望一切，你知道，

sentences.en: to be the way it was.
sentences.zh: 恢复到原来的样子。

sentences.en: Someday.
sentences.zh: 总有一天。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: It was, it was really wonderful to meet you.
sentences.zh: 能见到你真是太好了。

sentences.en: It was.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: It was such an honor to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 能和你交谈真是莫大的荣幸。

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.en: I will now announce the tally of the vote for the office of president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 我现在宣布美国总统选举的投票结果。

sentences.en: For Joseph R.
sentences.zh: 特拉华州的民主党人约瑟夫·R·拜登，

sentences.en: Biden of Delaware, a Democrat, eyes 55, nose zero.
sentences.zh: 赞成票55张，反对票0张。

sentences.en: In state houses across the country on Monday, members of the electoral college affirmed Joe Biden's victory.
sentences.zh: 周一，在全国各州的议会大厦，选举人团成员确认了乔·拜登的胜利。

sentences.en: Formerly pushing him past the 270 required votes, despite an unprecedented attempt by the president and his allies to delay, block, and overturn the process.
sentences.zh: 尽管总统及其盟友试图推迟、阻挠和推翻这一进程，但这一结果正式将他的票数推过了所需的270票。

sentences.en: In America, politicians don't take power.
sentences.zh: 在美国，政客们不会夺取权力。

sentences.en: People grant power to them.
sentences.zh: 是人民授予他们权力。

sentences.en: In a speech a few hours later, Biden sought to appeal to Trump supporters, but rebuked the president for his ongoing failure to accept the results of the election.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后的演讲中，拜登试图向特朗普的支持者示好，但同时也谴责了总统拒绝接受选举结果的持续行为。

sentences.en: The flame of democracy was lit in this nation a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 民主之火很久以前就在这个国家点燃了。

sentences.en: And we now know nothing, not even a pandemic or an abuse of power, can extinguish that flame.
sentences.zh: 现在我们知道，没有什么，即使是疫情或滥用权力，也无法熄灭那团火焰。

sentences.en: And Attorney General Bill Barr, who publicly broke with Trump over his claims of election fraud, is stepping down weeks before the end of the president's term.
sentences.zh: 司法部长比尔·巴尔因选举舞弊指控公开与特朗普决裂，他将在总统任期结束前几周离职。

sentences.en: Barr's resignation allows him to avoid future confrontations with Trump over both the election and Trump's plans for last-minute pardons, potentially of his own family members.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的辞职使他能够避免未来在选举以及特朗普最后一刻的特赦计划（可能涉及其家人）上与特朗普发生冲突。
